review_kind: Independent read-only exact-source lifecycle and test-coverage review. No runtime executed; no application edits; not acceptance.
disposition: No blocking lifecycle source defect found in the reviewed candidate delta. Conditional on runtime cases and preservation checks; does not certify fallback component internals, full original159, or all frontend behavior.

source_findings.condition: Accepted mutation observed before child readback failure
source_findings.finding: openUnitRegistry invokes parentLifecycle.confirmed immediately after awaited existing POST/PUT response, before confirmedUnit assignment, its own normalization GET, or render. Callback exceptions are isolated using constant warning text. GET recovery does not invoke confirmed again.

source_findings.condition: Deferred final-close read and multiple-save coalescing
source_findings.finding: On Units, main supplies the existing owned parent lifecycle; legacy saved callback returns immediately. confirmed marks changed and exposes pending status, but refresh requires closed. Multiple accepted saves while open therefore coalesce into one final-close parent GET pair. readback retries issue GET only; no mutation closure is retained.

Direct add-department-unit entry passes createNew true. Accepted response marks parent confirmed, clears dirty, sets busy false, then close removes dialog and calls closed; saved callback is a no-op for supplied Units lifecycle. No child normalization GET is needed on this branch. Current 72-case script does not execute this true branch.

notifyParentClosed has a one-way parentClosed guard. Explicit close notifies synchronously after dialog.close/remove/opener focus; queued native close listener cannot notify again. Native-only close also notifies. Existing workspaceDialog native close cleanup is registered first and removes dialog/restores permitted focus. Calling HTMLDialogElement.close programmatically bypasses dirty/busy refusal by design of the native API; supported UI close and cancel paths use guarded close.

source_findings.condition: Dirty and busy UI close refusal
source_findings.finding: close returns while busy, or when dirty discard confirmation is declined. cancel prevents native default then calls this guarded close. Declined dirty close cannot call closed. Existing lockWorkspaceControls disables rendered controls during mutation. Initial load close and saved-readback failure close remain supported; refreshSavedUnit loading close intentionally clears busy before close, allowing departure from a GET-only recovery.

source_findings.condition: Stale owner and latest read suppression
source_findings.finding: current binds account object, active view, viewSeq, renderSeq, root identity/connection, month and relevant existing overlay identity. refresh checks current before starting, then owned after reads; unitLoadSeq additionally rejects a newer Unit read. confirmed invalidates cached Unit data only for the same account, then drops stale parent callbacks. close of a stale registry cannot start a current-parent GET. Runtime supersession remains untested by this script.

Optional reference preparation rejection is converted into a throwing commit closure. This allows successful validated Unit board readback to paint before reporting reference refresh failure. changed is cleared only after successful commit; retry can read again without replaying POST/PUT. Focus recovery for an actually removed parent-owned node now precedes that throwing commit. No atomic board-and-reference DOM transaction is claimed.
